correctness.rationale: Exact conditional run compositions yield counts 2 A_m(j) and (n-2m) A_m(j)/m. Their within-block ratio is constant in j, and the next-block ratio [j(n-j)-m(n-m)]/m² is increasing in j. Thus the folded-composition kernel is TP2. Symmetric beta-binomial J weights have strictly increasing likelihood ratios in j for every b>a, because the adjacent ratio difference is (b-a)(n-2j-1)>0. Cauchy–Binet establishes all p_a(t)p_b(t_prime)-p_a(t_prime)p_b(t) minors nonnegative. Exact support witnesses make even-to-odd steps strict, while a universal counting identity gives odd-to-even equality. Fixed n limits follow from Beta weak limits. All boundaries and n=2 were included. The standalone exact-rational checker passed 1,882 finite assertions; finite checks do not establish the quantified theorem.

value.rationale: The number of adjacent color changes is the natural entire-runs statistic for diagnosing clustering/reinforcement in an exchangeable two-color sequence. Monotone likelihood-ratio ordering in the urn concentration uniformly controls every one-sided tail test at every sample length; the exact interval of equality cases supplies previously unidentified structural information, not merely a moment or single-threshold inequality. The proof identifies a reusable nontrivial TP2 kernel mechanism. The result makes no claim to a paper-sized contribution or to broader models.
